title: Testing, QA, CAPA, and crop review — controlled evidence plan
purpose: Define a cultivation QA workflow for deviations, affected-scope reconstruction, evidence review, laboratory/testing context, CAPA, effectiveness checks and periodic crop/process review.

excludedUntilValidated: automatic root cause from correlation alone
automatic product disposition without affected-scope evidence
retroactive deletion or rewriting of deviations
universal laboratory acceptance criteria detached from method/jurisdiction
closing CAPA only because an action was assigned

claims.statement: Deviation handling should preserve the original event, immediate containment, actual affected scope, supporting measurements, relevant records and unresolved uncertainty before final disposition or CAPA is assigned.
claims.boundary: A corrected process condition does not by itself resolve material impact or close the investigation.

claims.statement: Root-cause analysis should distinguish evidence-supported causal factors from contributing conditions and hypotheses instead of treating temporal association or operator blame as proof.
claims.boundary: The framework does not require one named root-cause tool; method choice should match consequence and complexity.

claims.statement: Corrective and preventive actions are stronger when linked to the investigated cause or system weakness and followed by a defined effectiveness check rather than closed at implementation.
claims.boundary: An effectiveness metric must be appropriate to the failure mode and cannot be fabricated merely to close a record.

claims.statement: Laboratory or COA results should be interpreted with sample identity, method, chain of custody, specification context and lot/process history so testing remains connected to the material actually represented.
claims.boundary: The SOP should not invent jurisdiction-specific release limits or treat one laboratory result as universally representative without a defensible sampling plan.

claims.statement: Periodic crop review should compare defined, stable metrics such as deviations, yield/quality outcomes, rework/holds, recurring plant-health signals and process variability using consistent denominators and definitions.
claims.boundary: Changing a KPI definition breaks direct comparability unless the change is documented and historical interpretation is reconciled.

claims.statement: Quality decisions should remain traceable to the evidence and authorization that supported release, hold, rework, rejection or further investigation.
claims.boundary: This educational QA model does not grant authority to release regulated product outside applicable facility and jurisdiction controls.
